create_dropout_tensor: create a dropout tensor that randomly zeroes elements of an input tensor with probability p
build_dropout_training: build a dropout operation for training mode that scales remaining elements by dividing by 1 minus p
test_dropout_probability: test the dropout function with a custom probability value between 0 and 1
refactor_dropout_inplace: refactor the dropout function to handle inplace operations with a warning during training
review_dropout_edge_cases: review the dropout function handling of edge cases where p equals 0 or 1
